facts.fact: The ITU report on the October 2025 Africa-BB-Maps national event says Burundi's legal and regulatory framework includes a 'Stratégie Large Bande 2025' (broadband strategy 2025) and a Universal Service Fund, with ARCT and SETIC as the lead bodies; the document gives no period dates and states no broadband targets, and names no successor.
